about_the_game:
You are a journalist driven by obsession—drawn to a chilling mystery involving five people who vanished without a trace. What began as a routine investigation quickly turns into something far more sinister.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Psychological Horror

The Hollow Path VR uses atmosphere, disorientation, and creeping dread to erode your sense of control. Spaces loop when they shouldn’t, audio cues mislead you, and the silence is never just silence. The fear isn’t in what you see—it’s in what you suspect you might have missed.

Narrative/Story

This is not just a story you uncover—it's a story you're becoming part of. Told through environmental storytelling, found objects, flashbacks, and unreliable narrators, The Hollow Path VR invites players to assemble their own interpretation of what truly happened. The deeper you go, the less clear the distinction becomes between investigation and obsession, and between journalist… and victim.

Evidence Collection

Scattered notes, damaged recordings, strange symbols, and remnants of personal belongings… Every clue offers a glimpse into the lives—and last moments—of the missing. As you piece together these fragments, you’ll begin to reconstruct a timeline that refuses to stay still. Some evidence leads to truth. Some may be planted to mislead you. Knowing the difference could mean survival.

The deeper you go, the more the world twists around you. The only thing more disturbing than the silence is the occasional sign that you’re not alone.

Will you uncover what happened to the missing five… or become the sixth?

WISHLIST NOW!

content_descriptors.notes: This is a horror game and may contain content such as gore, violence and scary scenes that could be disturbing for certain players. The game does NOT contain content involving sexual assault/non-consensual sex, BDSM, drug/alcohol abuse, and/or self-harm.
